summary: HDFC Bank Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointment of Puneet Sharma as CFO-Designate (effective Sep 1, 2026) and CFO (effective Dec 1, 2026) and Jigar Shah as General Counsel-Designate (effective Aug 20, 2026) and General Counsel (effective Oct 1, 2026). The board approved these based on committee recommendations. No terms such as price, premium, or stake are involved. This is a scheduled senior management succession, not a forced departure. The filing is an Indian regulatory disclosure under SEBI Listing Regulations, reported via Form 6-K. The event is an orderly transition of two key officer roles.
